commit.message: Changed Force-driven flow dependency to Resistive flow dependency.

@@ -10056,7 +10056,7 @@ In a biological membrane, the reversal potential (also known as the Nernst poten
 
 All resistive dependencies relate a force (or force differential) to a flow-rate property which is a generalization on Ohm's law discovered by Georg Ohm in the mid-1820's using recently discovered galvanometers. Ohm's law refers strictly to cases where the force-flow relation is, at least approximately, linear. Non-linear dependencies abound both in the fields of engineering (e.g., electrical diodes) and biology (e.g., turbulent fluid flow, membrane channel mediated ion flow)</OPB_01768>
         <rdfs:comment>A constitutive flow dependency by which a flow rate of a process depends on the gradient of forces the participating entities.</rdfs:comment>
